# Test fixtures and test bed (package 7)

Everything under `TEST-ONLY/` is **test-only** key material and passwords for the private
compose networks in `compose.dev.yaml`. None of it protects anything. Never copy a key from here
into a real `.ssh` folder or trust one of these host keys anywhere else.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `testbed.py` | The single source of truth: servers, users and passwords, TOTP secret, key passphrase, app password, fixture keys, fingerprints, `Totp` helper |
| `prompter.py` | `FakePrompter`: a scripted `portkey.interfaces.Prompter` (values, lists, callables, `CANCEL`) and `kbdint_answers()` |
| `sshclient.py` | `ssh_connect()` (asyncssh with exact credentials and the pinned host key), `load_client_key()`, `reset_user()` |
| `generate.py`, `generate.sh` | Regenerate `TEST-ONLY/` in the dev container |
| `TEST-ONLY/ssh/` | The fixture `.ssh` directory the `app` service runs against |
| `TEST-ONLY/sshd/` | What the sshd image is built from: host key sets A and B, users, `keyonly`'s authorized_keys, the TOTP file |

## The sshd test bed

Image `tests/sshd` (Ubuntu 24.04, OpenSSH, `libpam-google-authenticator`, fish). Passwords are
`TEST-ONLY-<user>-password`.

| User | Accepts | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pw` | password | `Match User`: password only |
| `keyonly` | publickey | `PasswordAuthentication no`; every fixture key except `port-key/` is pre-seeded |
| `fresh` | publickey, password, keyboard-interactive | no `~/.ssh` |
| `tfa` | publickey, keyboard-interactive | two rounds: `Password: `, then `Verification code: ` (TOTP, `testbed.TOTP_SECRET`) |
| `fishy` | any | login shell fish |
| `badperms` | any | `~/.ssh` is 0777, so StrictModes ignores its authorized_keys |
| `nosh` | any | login shell nologin: sign-in works, every command exits 1 with "This account is currently not available." |

| Service | Address | Host key | Networks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sshd` | `sshd:22`, `sshd:2222` | set A | outer and inner (the jump host) |
| `sshd-rekeyed` | `sshd-rekeyed:22` | set B | outer |
| `sshd-inner` | `sshd-inner:22` | set A | inner only: reach it with `tunnel=` through `sshd` |

The test runners (`integration`, `e2e`) and `app` are on `outer` only. Each sshd container keeps
its own state for the whole run; after a test installs a key, put the user back with
`reset_user("fresh")` (the integration fixture `reset_ssh_user`), which runs
`/usr/local/bin/portkey-test-reset` as that user.

## The fixture `.ssh` directory

| File | Why |
|---|---|
| `id_ed25519` (+ `.pub`) | the default key, plain, LF |
| `id_rsa` (+ `.pub`) | private key with CRLF; `.pub` in UTF-16 LE with BOM and CRLF (PowerShell 5 `>`) |
| `id_ecdsa` | no `.pub` (public key from the private file's cleartext block); UTF-8 BOM |
| `id_ed25519_pass` (+ `.pub`) | encrypted OpenSSH key, passphrase `testbed.KEY_PASSPHRASE` |
| `id_rsa_pass` (+ `.pub`) | encrypted legacy PEM (no public block, so the `.pub` is needed) |
| `port-key/id_ed25519_portkey` (+ `.pub`) | as if generated by Port-Key; not on any server |
| `work.ppk`, `broken_key` | must be reported as key problems (`ppk`, `not_private_key`) |
| `config`, `authorized_keys` | ordinary files that are not keys |
| `known_hosts` | CRLF; `sshd` plain, `[sshd]:2222`, `sshd-inner` hashed (all set A); `sshd-rekeyed` deliberately absent; fictional hosts (web-prod with two key types, build-box, `[imaging-01]:2222`, hashed vpn-gw and 10.8.0.1); a wildcard, an `@revoked` and an `@cert-authority` line |

A Windows bind mount shows every file as mode 0777. The `app` service copies this directory into
a tmpfs at `/ssh` and makes everything 0777 before starting; integration tests get the same
with the `fixture_ssh_dir` fixture. Git keeps the bytes as they are (`TEST-ONLY/.gitattributes`).

Note for known_hosts code: asyncssh's `match()` falls back to the port-less entry when no
`[host]:port` entry matches (OpenSSH does not), so `sshd` on port 2200 matches the `sshd` line.

## Regenerating

```sh
tests/fixtures/generate.sh            # create missing keys, rewrite derived files (deterministic)
tests/fixtures/generate.sh --force    # replace every key pair too
```

Change users, passwords or the TOTP secret in `testbed.py`, then regenerate; `./mk integration`
rebuilds the sshd image from `TEST-ONLY/sshd`.
